name: PunisherFinTheme
description: Restyles home and library cards, episode rows, and detail actions while preserving Jellyfin's native behavior.

versions.changelog: Adds an isolated live preview to the random-background settings. The preview selects a random backdrop from the currently selected Jellyfin library and updates opacity, brightness, blur, saturation, contrast, overlay darkness, crossfade duration, and image quality before settings are saved. Changing libraries automatically loads a matching preview, and a dedicated button selects another random image without altering the active site background.

Applies the configured accent color to Jellyfin's audio now-playing bar, including position and volume sliders, slider thumbs, active repeat, shuffle and favorite states, and control hover or keyboard focus. Also completes a broader accent audit for legacy and modern sliders, checkboxes, radio controls, switches, tabs, progress indicators, loading spinners, count badges, list actions, metadata selection, and reader controls. RGB channel variables are now generated from the selected color so translucent Jellyfin hover states no longer fall back to blue.

Extends the optional PunisherFin branding to the Jellyfin 12 administration drawer, replacing its server logo and displayed server name while preserving the version label. Browser-tab branding now updates Jellyfin's existing icon and shortcut-icon entries directly, ensuring the PunisherFin favicon is selected reliably and restored when branding is disabled.

Adds optional PunisherFin branding, enabled by default. The supplied PunisherFin logo replaces the Jellyfin header logo and browser favicon, while the displayed header server name becomes PunisherFin. Disabling the setting restores the original Jellyfin logo and server name without modifying the server's saved branding.

Keeps the Jellyfin 12 header transparent after scrolling on desktop and mobile. The fix now covers the modern MUI OffsetAppBar default-color and elevation states in addition to legacy skinHeader classes, removes scroll shadows and backdrops, and synchronizes late-rendered AppBar elements at runtime.

Fixes the two mobile library action buttons remaining blue when optional library styling is disabled. Material UI primary button groups now receive the configured accent directly at theme level, while legacy play-all and shuffle controls remain scoped to library pages.

Applies the configured accent color to the mobile library play-all, shuffle, and queue button group in both modern and legacy Jellyfin views. Video startup loading indicators now also use the selected accent color, including Jellyfin's MDL spinner and modern CircularProgress variants.

Keeps centered preview play buttons transparent during card and video-preview hover. The configured accent background is now applied only while the play button itself is hovered or keyboard-focused, including InPlayerEpisodePreview cards.

Adds dedicated accent-color integration for Namo2's InPlayerEpisodePreview plugin. Episode progress bars, centered play actions, played and favorite states, selected and hovered rows, popup controls, the player preview button, and popup scrollbars now follow the configured PunisherFinTheme accent color.

Removes the oversized solid accent block shown when hovering the volume slider in some Jellyfin clients. The volume tooltip bubble is now suppressed while the volume track and thumb retain the configured accent color.

Fixes player accent colors independently of the optional enlarged-player-controls setting. The configured accent now overrides Jellyfin's native cyan for player hover and focus states, active controls, playback and volume sliders, and scrubber thumbs. Expanded card preview play buttons now also use the configured accent color.

Applies the configured accent color throughout Jellyfin's video player, including button hover and focus states, active controls, playback progress, scrubber thumbs, volume sliders, slider bubbles, and current Material UI slider variants across Chromium, Firefox, and legacy WebViews.

Adds optional muted video clips to expanded previews for episodes, continue-watching items, seasons, series, movies, and newly added media. The option is enabled by default; disabling it preserves the existing static artwork preview. Only one bandwidth-limited preview plays at a time and automatically stops after twelve seconds.
Uses the configured accent color for expanded card preview borders and focus rings instead of overriding them with white.

Rebuilds the settings page lifecycle so saved checkboxes and sliders always load and persist independently of optional library and dependency requests. Adds immediate slider labels, API-readiness handling, reliable library fallback, and a browser-level load/change/save regression test.

Fixes the entire settings page initialization by selecting the active page reliably, loading configuration immediately, and replacing AbortController-dependent event bindings with compatible removable handlers.
Repackages the header and live slider fixes with a verified checksum to bypass the cached invalid 1.3.6.0 catalog entry.
Synchronizes slider labels directly from their live values and enforces a fully transparent scrolled header through both CSS and restored inline runtime styles.
Restricts rotating backdrops to home, library, and administration views. Detail pages and active video playback are now always excluded, with an additional CSS player safety boundary.

Fixes live slider values by binding controls to the active settings page, fully removes Jellyfin's scrolled header surface, refreshes cached theme assets after updates, and adds matching backdrop hover previews for season cards.
Applies the configured accent color to season count badges on series detail pages.
Fixes persistence and live value updates for background controls, replaces stale settings-page event handlers safely, and adds a button to restore all background defaults.
Keeps the Jellyfin top navigation transparent when scrolling instead of switching to an opaque black background.
Adds automatic rotating backdrop backgrounds from a selected library, with configurable opacity, brightness, blur, saturation, contrast, darkening, timing, crossfade, and image quality.
Constrains the mobile primary play action to a true 200px border-box width, preventing it from overlapping adjacent action buttons.
Makes the mobile primary play action compact and centered, and fixes mobile library browsing to a stable three-column grid without changing desktop layouts.
Removes Jellyfin's outer button background and native hover tooltip while preserving accessible labels, and constrains progress bars on season and episode detail cards to four pixels.
Ports the PunisherFin modern detail action geometry to Jellyfin Web: 54px primary action, 52px secondary circles, 24px icons, focused pill expansion, native labels, and resume position text.
Restores the fixed glass text area and fixed card dimensions during previews, and constrains playback progress to a slim four-pixel bar at the image edge.
Fixes blank media artwork and keeps hover previews at the existing card height so they expand horizontally instead of downward.
Adds landscape card previews with metadata for home rows, expanding PunisherFin-style detail actions, and larger Jellyfin Web player controls with hover and focus feedback.
Initial release with responsive PunisherFin-style home and library cards, episode rows, detail action buttons, configurable accent color, and protected Jellyfin header and hero areas.
